image_description: Two cast iron skillets resting on a metal wire rack, likely inside an oven or on a stovetop. The skillet on the left has a visible handle extending upwards. Both pans show signs of use with seasoned surfaces and some residue. The lighting is warm, creating reflections on the metal surfaces.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both objects clearly exhibit the shallow, wide circular geometry characteristic of frying pans.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The left skillet shows a handle that is integrated into the body (typical of cast iron) and appears proportional. A hanging hole is not clearly visible due to the angle/crop, but the handle structure is correct.
The transition from the base to the rim shows the characteristic slope of a skillet.
